# Conclusions and Future Work {#sec-ch-conclusions}
<!-- [PLACEHOLDER] -->

This thesis examined whether a continuous-control deep RL agent using
order-book-derived microstructure features can achieve economically
meaningful held-out performance in a high-frequency single-asset setting.
The answer, within the specified experimental design, is qualified but
affirmative: the following sections detail the evidence
(@sec-summary-of-findings), the limitations that bound this claim
(@sec-limitations-and-future-research), and their implications for
trading-system design and practice.
